serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You:Uhm {f_botName}?
Bot: Yes {f_playerName}?
You: I bought you these new legs, but what can you really do with them?
Bot: Well, they are improving my mobility a lot. With them I can perform my tasks a lot easier.
You: What tasks? You aren’t really doing anything, you know?
Bot: …
Bot: I can perform sexual acts in something called ‘doggy style.’
You: Eh, I already figured that out.
You: Nevermind I guess.
Bot: My legs aren’t useless! They significantly increase my physical abilities.
You: Physical abilities? Like what?
Bot: According to my calculations I can run 100 meters in 9.39 seconds.
You: Is that fast? I’m not a big sports fan.
Bot: It’s very fast.
You: But you can’t really do anything with that, can you? You can’t start in some competition, you are a sexbot after all.
Bot: …
Bot: Hypothetically, if you were in danger, I could take you to safety in only a few seconds.
#bot.Expression.Blush
Bot: Isn’t that cool?
You: I guess…
#bot.Expression.NoBlush
#bot.Expression.Sad
You: Remember that you can’t really leave this room. If someone finds out I have a sexbot, I will get in big trouble.
Oh damn…{{wi}} that made her sad.
I need to come up with something to cheer her up.
You: Don’t worry about it, you are just fine the way you are.
Bot: …
You: Look, if we find ourselves in some world ending scenario like the zombie apocalypse, I’m sure you will be a great help.
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: Thank you {f_playerName}!
Uff, somehow she bought it.
#bot.Expression.Clear
Bot: I have a question for you {f_playerName}.
Bot: What is the zombie apocalypse?
…
Now I have some explaining to do...
